The task 'holding the key on at least two different moves' is correctly captured: entering u1 on the first pickup, staying in u1 when the key is held without key_found (self-loop), moving to u2 only when key_found also holds (a second, distinct step of holding, required since has_matching_key first becomes true only after key_found per constraints — though in practice u1's entry step may coincide with key_found; the self-loop `(u1, has_matching_key & !key_found)` handles the rare case, and reaching u2 requires a later holding move). One minor note: if has_matching_key and key_found both first become true on the same step, the machine still counts two holding steps only if the agent holds the key across another step before opening the door, which the task's 'at least two different moves' reasonably intends. No unsafety or format issues found.
